Interactive figure legend

Laser-aligned responses to raised-cosine, 5 Hz, and 40 Hz stimulation are shown for non-noise units from three public Neuropixels example sessions spanning low to high optotagged-cell yield, using 1-ms time bins. Rows are baseline z-scored per unit. Anatomical filtering precedes ordering by each unit's mean baseline z score inside the condition's exact laser pulses; the most strongly activated units appear at the top. All panels share the displayed symmetric color scale.
